Initial release of the Dataify LinkedIn scraper request builder.

- Supports creating Dataify builder curl requests for LinkedIn company and job information scraping tools.
- Guides users in choosing one tool in Chinese, reading tool parameters, and collecting user input or presenting selectable options.
- Generates compliant JSON arrays for `spider_parameters`, supporting both single and multiple value scenarios.
- Uses Python (`build-dataify-request.py`) and PowerShell (`build-dataify-request.ps1`) scripts for cross-platform request building.
- Provides clear instructions for permanent environment variable setup of `DATAIFY_API_TOKEN`.
- Outputs the final curl request ready for submission to scraperapi.dataify.com/builder.
